title: PICACO: Pluralistic In-Context Value Alignment via Total Correlation Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with pluralistic human value sets, specifically evaluating and benchmarking performance on ethical and philosophical frameworks such as Confucianism (which includes virtues like Benevolence, Conformity, and Tradition) and Modern Liberalism. It aims to reconcile conflicting moral demands within prompts.
